selection.own_p95_band: Post-dispatch ranks above 94% through 96% within each engine and role.
selection.same_offers_slowest_5pct_union: Match the offered ordinal within a wave across engines when either arm places it in its slowest 5%.
selection.optimized_minus_stock_ns: Differences of selected phase means and of per-wave p95 medians over matched seeds. The selected populations can change with mode.
